audit.args:
{'code': "from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import QAction
mw = iface.mainWindow()
act = next(a for a in mw.findChildren(QAction) if a.objectName() == 'mActionHtmlAnnotation')
act.trigger()
mt = iface.mapCanvas().mapTool()
result = {'checked': act.isChecked(), 'mapTool': type(mt).__name__, 'mapToolActionObject': mt.action().objectName() if mt and mt.action() else None}"}
